title: One-handed touch compass and sector trick wheel redesign
summary: The touch trick wheel now selects by position, and the drive compass is redesigned around the thumb. The work is on PR #107 and is not public until that merges and deploys.
details: Trick wheel: the eight inner sectors match the two-finger swipe directions. Cat Nac and Cordova, plus the optional flips, sit in a red outer band. The selected sector fills gold and its full name shows above the wheel. Labels are one-line and outlined.

Compass: silver rim, a red throttle arc over the top, and the cue text sits above the ring, clear of the thumb. Preload uses the original HUD colours: a blue pulse (LIFT FOR PRELOAD) means lift now, an orange burst (PRELOADED) means it was achieved.
Axis labels, crosshair and the idle 'Hold anywhere to ride' hint are first-run coaching only and fade once the rider has learned the controls. The compass dims while the trick wheel is open.

Verification on PR #107: touch unit tests pass (24). test_trick_wheel passes in Chromium and WebKit at four viewports. test_enhanced_mobile, test_atv_flips, test_mobile_ui and test_touch pass on actual content in Chromium. Screenshots were captured and inspected by the implementation agent. Other captures (first-run idle hint, compass lift-for-preload, orange PRELOADED burst) are kept in ignored private/reports/devlog-images/touch-ui-redesign-*.png.
limitation: This is an authored browser touch adaptation, not the original PS2 UI. There has been no physical iOS or Android testing. Three touch tests (test_one_handed_touch, test_steering_sensitivity, test_mobile_utilities) remain in the manifest's broken group because they fail on unmodified main for menu-navigation reasons. Not publicly verified: it becomes public only once PR #107 merges and deploys.
caption: New sector trick wheel over gameplay on a phone viewport: Cat Nac is selected in the red outer band, filled gold, with its full name above the wheel; the compass dims beneath it.
